body:
**Mondo term (ID Label)**
MONDO:0021227, adrenal gland neoplasm

**Bug/Typo/Error description**
I believe there is an error in the equivalencies files. The `ONTOTREE:ADRENAL_GLAND` xref has the IRI `http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ADRENAL_GLAND` in the equivalencies file instead of `http://oncotree.mskcc.org/api/tumorTypes/search/code/ADRENAL_GLAND`. On OLS4 the xref on the corresponding Mondo term appears to be correct.

I'm guessing there's an automated pipeline for creating these equivalencies from xrefs and it doesn't properly handle underscores for mskcc IRIs. As far as I can tell, this is the only case like this.

Results of `grep -E "^id:" equivalencies.obo | sed -E 's/id: ([^:]+).*/\1/' | sort | uniq -c`: 
```
 1 ADRENAL
 49 DECIPHER
6042 DOID
11493 http
 954 ICD10CM
 116 ICD10WHO
 760 ICD9
  1 ICD9CM
11371 MEDGEN
5081 MESH
14190 MONDO
```
_(the http group are all to UMLS and oncotree)_

https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0593-3569
